_note: Proposed by BE-L for F10-T10 and the coach_message_hook kinds (D81, D91): text for the LINE messages that have no board (they use the Booking confirmed card style) and the few lines the boarded cards need beyond the existing L keys. Numbers to be assigned by Content (F10-T20); wording drafted, writers own it. Existing keys reused: L-0001, L-0004, L-0009 to L-0019, L-0021, L-0024, L-0031 to L-0041, L-0058; from locales/pending/f13.json: L-new.receipt_credit_used. Variables follow locales/README.md.
